fact: The Rwanda Innovation Fund, a venture capital initiative of about $68.6 million backed by the African Development Bank and the Government of Rwanda and managed by Angaza Capital, had backed 12 technology companies by 2024, according to KT Press.

The New Times reports that Rwanda's Startup Act, announced about five years earlier, has not been enacted or tabled in Cabinet, with the ICT Chamber CEO saying multiple drafts and validations are still under way.
